title: Dynamic HDR tooling and config phase 2
summary: Dynamic HDR Phase 2 adds operator-controlled tool resolution and config/schema scaffolding for future Dolby Vision and HDR10+ preservation work.
reason: Phase 1 only detected and reported dynamic HDR metadata. Phase 2 needs pinned tool drop-zones, nonfatal startup discovery, explicit operator policy keys, and unit coverage before preservation behavior can be safely designed.
